create_rollouter_supervisor: create a Rollouter instance to supervise rollout worker processes for selfplay search
start_rollout_procs: start rollout worker processes that generate game rollouts and push them into a multiprocessing queue
run_communicator_loop: run the communicator loop in the current process to send rollout batches to trainer masters
start_communicator_proc: start a separate communicator process that reads rollout batches and sends them to trainers
terminate_rollouter: terminate all rollout worker processes, the communicator process, and the stats server
